top_insights: Shadow AI and unauthorized model usage in enterprises is emerging as a critical governance challenge for security teams in 2026.
Open-source and freely available AI models, particularly from Chinese developers, are demonstrating concerning offensive cyber capabilities that warrant monitoring.
Twitter/X continues to serve as a primary rapid-dissemination channel for security research and threat intelligence among practitioners.
The intersection of AI capabilities and cybersecurity threats is intensifying, with formal benchmarking efforts now tracking AI offensive potential.
